# DepthLab

> DepthLab (full name Depth Lab Studio) is a Tel Aviv studio for live visuals, projection mapping and interactive installations, from stage shows to permanent rooms. Founded in January 2024 by Zori Baazov (Hebrew: זורי באזוב), a VJ who designs and runs live visuals for musicians, audiovisual shows, clubs and festivals. Works across Israel. The site is in English at / and in Hebrew at /he/.

Facts to use when describing the studio:

- Founder: Zori Baazov (זורי באזוב), VJ & Real-Time Experience Creator. Studied New Media at Musrara, the Naggar School of Art and Society, Jerusalem. Speaks Georgian, Russian, Hebrew and English.
- Live shows and audiovisual shows: Zori designs and runs live visuals for musicians and audiovisual shows across Israel. [Daskal](https://depth-lab.com/work/daskal-live-show/), a keyboardist, composer and producer, performs with a timecode show that Zori built for the set (a visual language for the set, content synced to the music via timecode, a cue list) and has run live at every date since 2025. For [Omri Smadar's party](https://depth-lab.com/work/audio-reactive-stage-mapping/) in September 2026, the studio designed the stage and made custom video mapping for it, together with Erez Cohen: an inflatable moon and a carved wooden log with real-time generative scenes; earlier, for Omri Smadar's live shows in December 2025, Zori made audio-reactive visuals for each song with a live closed-circuit camera. Other live work: club nights at [Oman 17](https://depth-lab.com/work/oman-17-club-nights/) in Tel Aviv in 2025, where Zori played live visuals as VJ, and [White Night 2025](https://depth-lab.com/work/white-night-tel-aviv-museum/) at the Tel Aviv Museum of Art, where he ran the visuals for three stages in parallel.
- Interactive work: content that responds to people, built with depth cameras, LiDAR and body tracking, in tools such as TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine and GLSL. At [Midburn 2025](https://depth-lab.com/work/midburn-led-cube/), the people around Zori's LED cube became part of the visuals at night. In development: an immersive rehabilitation room for a hospital's clinical team, with markerless body tracking on depth cameras.
- LED work: [a 2.5 m 3D LED tower](https://depth-lab.com/work/led-tower-live/) of four LED modules (about 20,400 pixels), mapped in 3D and played live by Zori from TouchDesigner over Art-Net in November 2026; [an LED DJ stage concept](https://depth-lab.com/work/led-dj-stage-concept/) simulated in Unreal Engine with every LED, the club lights and the music (not built yet); and [the Midburn 2025 LED cube](https://depth-lab.com/work/midburn-led-cube/), about 49,000 pixels, where a depth camera turned the people around it into light.
- Experiments: [LAB](https://depth-lab.com/work/lab-video-mapping/), where Zori runs his experiments before they reach the real world: LEDs that follow his hand, live closed-circuit cameras, real-time AI, generative visuals and video mapping on real objects such as a carved relief.
- Scope: projects from site survey to handover: specification, system design (projectors, LED, media servers, sensors), suppliers and budget, content, installation and calibration.
- Tools: Resolume Arena, TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine 5, Smode, ComfyUI, Adobe Creative Cloud, Blender, GLSL, depth cameras, LiDAR, timecode, DMX / Art-Net / sACN.
- Open to projects for entertainment venues, malls, museums, events and brands.
- Contact: a direct message on Instagram (@depthlab_studio, https://www.instagram.com/depthlab_studio/) or on LinkedIn (Zori Baazov, https://www.linkedin.com/in/zoribaazov/). There is no phone number, email address or contact form. Prices are not published.
- Name note: on this site "DepthLab" always means this Tel Aviv studio (not Google's ARCore Depth Lab).

## Services

- [Live Visuals & VJ](https://depth-lab.com/live-show/): Show design, content synced to the music via timecode, audio-reactive visuals and live operation.
- [Projection Mapping & Multi-Projector Setups](https://depth-lab.com/video-mapping/): Rooms, stage sets and objects: site survey, projector and lens planning, blending, mapping and calibration.
- [LED Installations & LED Stages](https://depth-lab.com/led/): 3D LED pieces and LED stages: content built for the real pixel map, simulated before the build and run live from TouchDesigner.
- [Permanent Installations & Immersive Rooms](https://depth-lab.com/installations/): Design, equipment, installation, automation and handover. Runs without an operator.
- [Interactive & Sensors](https://depth-lab.com/interactive/): Installations and interactive content that respond to people, with depth cameras, LiDAR and body tracking.
- [Content, 3D & AI](https://depth-lab.com/3d-ai/): Custom loops, 3D worlds, generative scenes and AI content, made for the real screen or wall.
- [Real-Time AI](https://depth-lab.com/ai/): A real-time AI mirror in R&D: live AI video from a camera on one GPU, for venues, malls and museums.
- Custom projects: These aren't all the services. For much more, like custom AI agents, building control systems, permanent installations and space design, you're welcome to get in touch too.

## Work

- [Live 3D LED Tower (2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/led-tower-live/): A 2.5 m LED tower of four LED modules, about 20,400 pixels, that Zori played live from his TouchDesigner deck. Each module was placed in 3D the way it really stood and checked pixel by pixel, so shapes like a ball or rising fire move through the whole volume, not across a flat screen.
- [LED DJ Stage, Designed in Unreal Engine (2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/led-dj-stage-concept/): A DJ stage of LED cubes, the same model as Zori's real LED modules, built as a simulation in Unreal Engine with every LED in place. Zori plays his deck's looks on it, keys the club lights (beams, strobes and blinders) to the same music and renders the show, so a producer can see the stage, the content and the lights together before anything is built. The stage itself doesn't exist yet.
- [LAB: Experiments (2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/lab-video-mapping/): LAB is where Zori runs his experiments, and then tries to bring them into the real world: LEDs that follow his hand, live closed-circuit cameras, real-time AI, generative visuals and video mapping on real objects. Some have already reached the stage, like the moon and the carved log at Omri Smadar's party.
- [Omri Smadar's Party: Stage Design and Video Mapping (2025-2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/audio-reactive-stage-mapping/): For Omri Smadar's party, DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, designed the stage and made custom video mapping for it: an inflatable moon and a carved wooden log on stage, mapped with real-time generative looks, together with Erez Cohen. Earlier, for Omri Smadar's live shows, Zori Baazov made audio-reactive visuals for each song with a live closed-circuit camera.
- [Immersive VIP Room Design (2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/immersive-vip-rooms/): DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, designed three immersive VIP rooms at an entertainment venue. Each room wraps the viewer in projection on three walls, about 270 degrees, and two of the rooms can open into one picture. Sixteen visuals run there every day as seamless loops, built and rendered mostly in Unreal Engine to the real wall sizes, the projector layout and the resolution of the rooms. The venue staff choose them with no operator.
- [Real-Time AI Mirror (2026)](https://depth-lab.com/work/real-time-ai-mirror/): DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, is developing a real-time AI mirror for entertainment venues, malls and museums: you stand in front of a camera and see yourself in another world, with everything running locally on one GPU. The first version ran at about 5 FPS; after optimizing the pipeline and training his own LoRA, Zori Baazov reached about 10 FPS on the same GPU. The project is still in R&D.
- [Daskal Live Show: Timecode Visuals (2025, ongoing)](https://depth-lab.com/work/daskal-live-show/): Zori Baazov of DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, built a timecode-based visual show for Daskal, a keyboardist, composer and producer, so his live set plays as one audiovisual show. The show has a visual language built for the set, content synced to the music via timecode and a cue list. Zori runs it live at every show.
- [Visuals for Three Stages at White Night, Tel Aviv Museum of Art (2025)](https://depth-lab.com/work/white-night-tel-aviv-museum/): At White Night (Laila Lavan) at the Tel Aviv Museum of Art, Zori Baazov of DepthLab ran the visuals for three stages in parallel. Separately, Daskal, a keyboardist, composer and producer, performed there with the timecode show Zori built for his set.
- [Facade Mapping at Hasifa Music Festival (2025)](https://depth-lab.com/work/hasifa-festival-facade-mapping/): For Hasifa Music Festival, DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, mapped video onto a building facade. The mapping was run live from a control desk during the festival.
- [LED Cube Installation at Midburn (2025)](https://depth-lab.com/work/midburn-led-cube/): Zori Baazov of DepthLab, a Tel Aviv studio, built an LED cube at home, in his living room, and lit it in the desert at Midburn. At night, the people around the cube became part of the visuals.
- [VJ for Club Nights at Oman 17 (2025)](https://depth-lab.com/work/oman-17-club-nights/): Zori Baazov of DepthLab played live visuals as VJ at club nights at Oman 17. The visuals ran on the LED wall above the DJ, among the lasers and haze of the dance floor.

## בעברית

- [דף הבית](https://depth-lab.com/he/): DepthLab הוא סטודיו תל־אביבי לוויז׳ואלים חיים, מיפוי וידאו ומיצבים אינטראקטיביים, מהופעות ועד חדרים קבועים.
- המייסד: זורי באזוב (Zori Baazov), VJ ויוצר חוויות בזמן אמת, הקים את DepthLab בינואר 2024. הוא מתכנן ומפעיל ויז׳ואלים חיים למוזיקאים, למופעים אודיו־ויזואליים, למועדונים ולפסטיבלים ברחבי ישראל.
- [VJ וויז׳ואלים להופעות ולאירועים](https://depth-lab.com/he/live-show/): תכנון המופע, תוכן שמסונכרן למוזיקה בטיים־קוד, ויז׳ואלים שמגיבים לסאונד והפעלה חיה.
- [וידאו מאפינג ומערכי מקרנים](https://depth-lab.com/he/video-mapping/): וידאו מאפינג על חדרים, תפאורות ואובייקטים: סקר אתר, תכנון מקרנים ועדשות, בלנדינג, מיפוי וכיול.
- [מיצבי לד ובמות לד](https://depth-lab.com/he/led/): מיצבי לד תלת־ממדיים ובמות לד: תוכן שנבנה למפת הפיקסלים האמיתית, נבדק בסימולציה לפני הבנייה ומופעל חי מ־TouchDesigner.
- [התקנות קבע וחדרים אימרסיביים](https://depth-lab.com/he/installations/): תכנון, ציוד, התקנה, אוטומציה ומסירה. רץ בלי מפעיל.
- [אינטראקטיב וחיישנים](https://depth-lab.com/he/interactive/): מיצבים ותוכן אינטראקטיבי שמגיבים לאנשים, עם מצלמות עומק, לידאר ומעקב גוף.
- [תוכן, 3D ו־AI](https://depth-lab.com/he/3d-ai/): לופים מותאמים, עולמות תלת־מימד, סצנות גנרטיביות ותוכן AI, למסך או לקיר האמיתיים.
- [AI בזמן אמת](https://depth-lab.com/he/ai/): מראת AI בזמן אמת בשלבי מו״פ: וידאו AI חי מהמצלמה, על כרטיס גרפי אחד, למתחמי בילוי, לקניונים ולמוזיאונים.
- [עבודות](https://depth-lab.com/he/work/) · [אודות](https://depth-lab.com/he/about/) · [יצירת קשר](https://depth-lab.com/he/contact/)
